notes: Model: exact parts, as in Fusion or FreeCAD (OpenCascade): a sketch's solid has true circles and curves; its History adds Fillet and Chamfer on edges you click and Shell (hollow it, open at faces you click); they follow when the sketch changes
Model: Export STEP: the exact parts, for Fusion, SolidWorks, Onshape, FreeCAD or a machine shop
Model: a STEP file imported (Ctrl+I) stays exact: fillet, shell or pattern it, and send it back out as STEP
Model: Joints (Rigid, Hinge, Slider) hold one part to another: drive them with a slider or Play, and the part moves with what it's held to; Check collisions finds parts that overlap
Model: Technical drawing (Send menu): front, top and side views (first or third angle) with hidden edges, sizes, an isometric view and a title block, on A4 or A3; saved as a PDF to print and an SVG
Sketch: Coincident, Concentric and Tangent between shapes (circles too: click a centre or a rim); Sizes shows every edge's length and each circle's diameter
Model: Loft between sketches, Sweep along a path, Spring or coil round a helix (Add › CAD); Pattern, Round pattern and Mirror in an exact part's Features
Model: Parameters: named sizes (wall = 2) any History box can use, or a sum of them (wall * 5); change one and every part that uses it is made again
